Licensed Land Surveyor (LS)
jobs.description:
Build Your Future at AMT
A. Morton Thomas and Associates, Inc. (AMT), an employee-owned engineering consulting firm, is seeking a motivated Virginia Licensed Surveyor (LS) to join our growing Survey practice in Richmond or Northern Virginia.
This opportunity is designed for a survey professional who is ready to take the next step in their career. Whether you've recently obtained your Virginia license or are looking to expand your leadership responsibilities, AMT offers the opportunity to serve in responsible charge of survey projects, mentor staff, develop client relationships, and contribute to the continued growth of our Survey practice.
Our survey professionals work closely with AMT's transportation and infrastructure engineering teams. The work primarily includes topographic, boundary, right-of-way, and utility surveys supporting roadway, bridge, utility, and public infrastructure design projects supporting our public sector clientele. 
As an employee-owned company, AMT invests in its people through mentorship, professional development, leadership opportunities, and a collaborative culture that values teamwork, client service, and work-life balance. We are looking for a future leader who wants to make a meaningful impact on our projects, clients, teams, and communities. Surveyors who have recently obtained their Virginia Licensed Surveyor credential are encouraged to apply.
Why This Opportunity Is Different
At AMT, leadership opportunities are created through growth, not simply through waiting for someone else to retire.  This position offers the opportunity to:
Serve in responsible charge of survey projects.
Lead and mentor survey field and office personnel.
Gain greater project management responsibility.
Develop client management and business development skills.
Work closely with transportation and infrastructure engineering teams.
Build leadership experience within an employee-owned company.
Help shape the future growth of AMT's Survey practice.
Enjoy flexible hybrid work arrangements and a strong commitment to work-life balance.
We are looking for more than a licensed surveyor. We're looking for a future leader. If you've recently earned your Virginia Licensed Surveyor credential and are looking for an opportunity to expand your responsibilities, lead projects and staff, worn on meaningful transportation and infrastructure projects, and accelerate your professional growth, AMT offers the platform and support to help you succeed.
Join AMT and help shape the future of surveying throughout Virginia and the Mid-Atlantic region.

jobs.title: Survey Assistant
jobs.description:
At Beedie, we foster talent, encourage innovation, and reward success.

We’re always looking for like-minded people to join our team and share our passion for doing the best work of our lives. Our approach is simple: we work hard, we have fun, and we make a difference. And, we’ve been recognized as a top employer provincially and nationally. Our people are the heart and soul of our organization. If you are passionate, hardworking, ambitious, and want to be part of a dynamic and growing company that will take your career forward, join us.

Are you interested in starting your career in land surveying and development? As a Survey Assistant (Entry Level Grademan), you’ll work closely with our surveyors to gather essential site information and support a variety of field tasks. This is an entry-level role, ideal for candidates with a foundational understanding of surveying who are eager to learn and grow. We offer comprehensive training and mentorship to help you build your skills and advance in the field.
You’ll assist with preparing documents, drawings, and maps, setting up and using survey equipment, and supporting layout and measurement activities on site. The role involves hands-on work outdoors, including clearing survey lines, installing stakes, and recording geographical data. If you’re reliable, proactive, and ready to work as part of a collaborative team, we encourage you to apply!
